notes.title: Quick update #2
notes.content:
Greetings, 

The second quick update is here with such fixes and improvements:

[list]
    [*]Difficulty of all the bosses has been increased
    [*]The damage of "terrifying kamikaze" has been increased
    [*] The behaivor and damage of "the enemy with lightning" have been changed
    [*]The look and behaivor of the blue gun has been improved
    [*]Another typo fixes
    [*]"Lucky shot" achievement has been improved, now you need to be more lucky to get it
    [*]The help info has been updated
    [*]Other minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

I hope these fixes improve your gameplay experience and thanks for your continued support.

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[/list]

Thanks everyone for your constructive feedback!
